arguments.rationale: Selected a conservative, data-free Householder reflection W'=(I-2uu^T)W in only layer 23's MLP down projection and attention output projection. The unit direction u is the fixed </think>-versus-<think> embedding difference weighted by the fixed effective final-normalization gains. This preserves each matrix's singular values in exact arithmetic and reverses a measured late-layer anti-termination component without changing embeddings, output head, normalization, architecture, or generation settings. Probes showed higher closure probability at completed calculations with little change to numerical continuations. Important limitation: no practice accuracy gain was demonstrated; base scored 0/8 and this candidate scored 0/4 on comparable problems, all reaching the 2048-token limit. Broader semantic, memory, row-norm, stronger-control, and head-ablation experiments were reverted. This is the selected mechanistically motivated experimental candidate, not a claimed validated improvement.
